name: Objects of Desire
source:
Athena is a down-on-her-luck dom & poly career gal who can’t seem to find love, no matter what she does. But, when she stumbles upon the Objects of Desire cafe, she meets 3 men who might be able to give her what she needs…& something more.

[From [url=https://ianaro.itch.io/objects-of-desire]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雅典娜是一位运气不佳的多欲职业女孩，无论她做什么，她似乎都找不到爱情。但是，当她偶然发现“Objects of Desire”咖啡馆时，她遇到了3个男人，他们或许能够满足她的需求……以及更多。

[来自[url=https://ianaro.itch.io/objects-of-desire]itch.io[/url]]
